agent_types.CoordinatorAgent: Manages and oversees the interactions between various agents, ensuring system-wide objectives are met.
agent_types.WorkerAgent: Performs specific tasks or computations as directed by the CoordinatorAgent, contributing to the overall goal of the system.
agent_types.CommunicationAgent: Facilitates communication between agents, ensuring information is efficiently transmitted and understood among participants.
agent_types.MonitoringAgent: Observes system performance and activities, reporting anomalies or performance metrics to the CoordinatorAgent for corrective actions.
agent_types.DecisionAgent: Analyzes information gathered from other agents and external sources to make informed decisions to guide the system's actions towards its objectives.
